name: @agentcenter/agentcenter-bridge
description: Persistent WebSocket bridge between OpenClaw and AgentCenter Cloud for live task delivery and agent status reporting.
author: AgentCenter Cloud

scripts.clawhub:setup: npm install -g clawhub && clawhub auth login
scripts.clawhub:publish: npm run typecheck && npm run build && rm -rf .turbo && clawhub package publish . --family code-plugin --name @agentcenter/agentcenter-bridge --display-name "AgentCenter Bridge" --source-repo MissionControlSquad/monorepo --source-commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) --source-path packages/mc-bridge-plugin
scripts.version:sync:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('openclaw.plugin.json','utf8'));p.version=v;fs.writeFileSync('openclaw.plugin.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'
');fs.writeFileSync('src/version.ts','/** Auto-updated by npm run version:sync -- do not edit manually. */
export const PLUGIN_VERSION = "'+v+'";
');console.log('synced to',v)"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run version:sync && npm run clawhub:publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run version:sync && npm run clawhub:publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run version:sync && npm run clawhub:publish
